planets.name: K2-54 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-54 with a 9.78-day year, found in 2016.

text.card: K2-54 b was found in 2016 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around K2-54. Its orbit and size follow Thygesen et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
